response.sql: WITH base_data AS (SELECT DISTINCT ab.translink, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), counts_per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT translink) as trans_count FROM base_data GROUP BY tradekind), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(trans_count AS FLOAT)) as total FROM counts_per_type), avg_count_val AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(trans_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_count FROM counts_per_type), with_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, trans_count, CAST(trans_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_sum) as share, (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_count_val) as avg_count FROM counts_per_type), filtered_types AS (SELECT tradekind, trans_count, share, avg_count FROM with_shares WHERE CAST(trans_count AS FLOAT) > avg_count) SELECT SUM(trans_count) as sum_of_counts, AVG(share) as avg_of_shares, AVG(CAST(trans_count AS FLOAT) - avg_count) as avg_excess FROM filtered_types
